title: BYO corpus record — s3
description: An S3 object. content -> the object body (served verbatim by GetObject). `bucket` is the grouping/ACL unit; `key` is the object key/path within the bucket.

title.description: Human title (metadata; the key is the address).

key.description: The object key (path within the bucket).

bucket.description: The bucket this object belongs to, named the way S3 names one: 3-63 characters of lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens, beginning and ending with a letter or digit. It is the first half of a served object's identity and a host label in the virtual-hosted URL S3 hands back, so a slash, an uppercase letter or an underscore is refused -- none of them can be served, and a slash splits the address.

group.description: ACL group owning the bucket (default: slug(bucket)); null means the container owns no group, so nothing is group-scoped to it.

author_name.description: The author's display name, used for their principal entry (this API exposes no owner display name on the document itself).

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the bucket's group, private = owner only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.
